Title: A Legacy of Care: Unveiling the Connection between Anglican Retirement Villages and Anglicare Sydney

In the heart of Sydney, a tale of compassion and dedication unfolds, as two esteemed organizations, Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, and Anglicare Sydney, intertwine their histories to form a powerful narrative of community service and benevolence. Chapter 1: The Roots of Compassion

The story begins in the early 20th century, when the Anglican Diocese of Sydney recognized the growing need for social services in their community. In response, they established Anglicare Sydney, a not-for-profit organization dedicated to providing support to the most vulnerable members of society. As the years passed, Anglicare Sydney expanded its reach, offering a range of services from childcare to aged care, cementing its position as a beacon of hope for those in need. Chapter 2: A New Chapter in Care

In the 1960s, the Anglican Diocese of Sydney took another significant step in its mission to serve the community. They established Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, a public benevolent institution designed to provide affordable and comfortable living arrangements for seniors. This new initiative was born out of a deep understanding of the importance of dignity and independence in one's golden years. Chapter 3: The Connection Revealed

As we delve deeper into the histories of these two organizations, a crucial connection begins to emerge. Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is, in fact, an integral part of Anglicare Sydney. This relationship is not merely a coincidence; rather, it is a deliberate design, born out of a shared vision to serve the community. Evidence of this connection can be found in the governance structure of Anglican Retirement Villages. The organization is overseen by the Anglicare Sydney Board, which ensures that the values and mission of Anglicare Sydney are upheld in the provision of retirement village services. This shared governance structure is a testament to the symbiotic relationship between the two organizations. Furthermore, Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is listed as a subsidiary of Anglicare Sydney in the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC) register. This official recognition solidifies the connection between the two organizations, demonstrating that they are, in fact, part of the same entity.
